title: uor-agent/web-answer/1
description: One answer as the website is given it. Public: it holds no question, no author, no time, and no label of a turn's records. Named by its question key, the BLAKE3 kappa label of the normalized question, the manifest label and, for a follow-up, the keys of the earlier answers it builds on, which a browser computes itself. The record's own label (uor-addr, JCS + NFC) is sent beside it, so a browser can check what it received.

key.description: The question key: the label of {type: web-question, question: <normalized question>, manifest: <manifest label>}, with after: [<keys>] when the answer builds on earlier ones.

manifest.description: The label of the uor-agent/web-manifest/1 record this answer was computed under.

band.description: The score band the kernel was told. With the number of sources it is what decision 6 was asked.

level.description: The claim level the kernel combined from the sources (decision 7); null when nothing is claimed.

text.description: The answer, after the outgoing content filter (decision 13).

decision.description: A community decision the answer states, answered by the community holo at this commit; null when there is none.

sources.description: Every source the answer was written from, most trusted first (decision 8), each a public item the kernel serves on the website (decisions 10 and 17). Empty when nothing is claimed.

n.description: The number the answer cites it by.

cited.description: Whether the answer cites it by number. An answer that cites none is shown them all.

tools.description: How many tool calls the answer used. An answer that used one is open at most and is never reused.

kernel.description: The agent's holo, by the BLAKE3 label of its bytes.

community.description: The community holo, by the BLAKE3 label of its bytes.

after.description: The question keys of the earlier answers of the conversation this answer builds on, oldest first, as the kernel admitted them (decision 31): at most three, each read back by this host by its key. Absent when the answer stands alone, so such an answer has the label it always had.
